§151(b)
§151(d)(1)
§151(d)(3)
§68(b)(1)(C)

## Reasoning
Alice is an unmarried individual, so her filing status falls under §1(c). Her gross income of $311,510 exceeds the applicable amount of $250,000 under §68(b)(1)(C), triggering the exemption phaseout under §151(d)(3).

The phaseout calculation: AGI exceeds the threshold by $61,510 ($311,510 - $250,000). The applicable percentage is 25% (1% for each $2,500 or fraction thereof: $61,510 ÷ $2,500 = 24.604, rounded up to 25 increments).

Her personal exemption is reduced by 25%: $2,000 × (1 - 0.25) = $1,500.

Her taxable income is calculated as:
Gross income ($311,510) - Standard deduction ($3,000 under §63(b)(2)(C)) - Personal exemption ($1,500) = $307,010.

Under §1(c)(v), the tax is $79,772 plus 39.6% of the excess over $250,000:
$79,772 + (0.396 × $57,010) = $79,772 + $22,575.96 = $102,347.96.

Rounded to the nearest dollar: $102,348.

Answer: 102348
